summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill is part of a package that would create a shared equity program called Help to Buy, which would help low- to middle-income earners buy homes with a government contribution.
Housing Australia would run and oversee the program in states that have referred power or adopted the Commonwealth law, and in the territories.
The package would support 40,000 households and start the day after the bill receives Royal Assent.
changes: Establishes the Help to Buy shared equity program for low- to middle-income earners.
Gives Housing Australia responsibility for administering and monitoring the program.
Makes amendments to existing Commonwealth legislation through the Consequential Provisions Bill.
summary.affected: Low- to middle-income earners, Housing Australia, and states and territories that participate in the program.
